objective: Add the next cloud-first System domain slice for profile calibration, attributes, skills, achievements, shop/rewards and notifications while preserving one PostgreSQL event ledger as the only mutable derived-state owner and leaving all current values uninitialized until explicitly calibrated from authoritative evidence.

roles_before.artifact: Ron OS and claim-specific live owners own real-world truth.
PostgreSQL system_events is the single mutable owner of derived System state.
system_apply_action is the shared PostgreSQL mutation gate used by Northflank HTTP and ChatGPT-through-Neon.
Level, rank, attributes and economy calibration remain null/UNCALIBRATED rather than fabricated.
PWA reads the same snapshot and currently exposes status/quests/skills/achievements/shop/log placeholders.
LifeUp remains optional downstream integration and does not own cloud core state.

role_dispositions.destination: New calibration actions must carry explicit provenance/claim status; no System event promotes itself above Ron OS/live-owner truth.
All new domain state is reconstructed from system_events; no second mutable profile/skill/shop database owner is introduced.
New actions are accepted only through system_apply_action with matching JS defensive validation and idempotency semantics.
Explicit profile calibration events may initialize selected fields; fields never calibrated remain null/UNCALIBRATED and no default level/rank/stat values are invented.
The placeholder STATUS/SKILLS/ACHIEVEMENTS/SHOP projection surface is replaced by real snapshot-backed cards plus notifications while continuing to read the same API and ledger.
Legacy bridge remains untouched and optional.

capability_probes.assertion: A fresh ledger still exposes null level/rank/attributes and UNCALIBRATED economy; UI renders unknown/uninitialized instead of synthetic values.
Every new profile/attribute/skill/achievement/shop/notification projection remains rebuildable only from system_events, preserving the existing single-owner contract.
New actions use the same PostgreSQL system_apply_action path from both direct Neon and HTTP clients.
Existing quest, verified progression, idempotency and append-only invariants remain unchanged.
Existing LifeUp bridge CI remains green and no bridge file is modified.

tests.command: Extend model tests for profile calibration, attributes, skills, achievements, shop/reward catalog and notifications.
tests.expected: PASS with explicit unknown preservation and deterministic replay.
